title: Matthew Dicks - Videos
description:
Matthew Dicks is a storyteller, teacher, keynote speaker, internationally bestselling author of Storyworthy, and 64x Moth StorySLAM champion. He believes every life contains stories worth telling, and that the right story, told well, can change the way people see themselves and the world.

Matthew has devoted his life to helping people find, shape, and tell the stories that make them heard, trusted, and remembered. A world in which more people speak with honesty, courage, humor, and heart is a world in which fewer people feel alone. Every day is an opportunity to tell a story that matters.

Official Matthew Dicks / Storyworthy account.

Learn more at matthewdicks.com.
